task.title: End of training — Good cause shown

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy and Digest 19.2.7 — Disqualification — Withdrawal from a course or an employment activity . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy Digest 19.2.7 — Disqualification — Withdrawal from a course or an employment activity

step.cmd: Determine if the claim is in MPS:
In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for the referred training issue:

ul.li:
If yes, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and complete it as follows:
Claim Allowed: Select NCA - No changes to the claim .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 4.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Project Data - Training (M171) transaction and input the correct end date as follows:

ul.li: End date: Select the correct end date of the training.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a revised registration number for the referred training issue:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “EIA 25 — Change to the training end date is required.”
Remarks line 3: If necessary, enter the claimant’s report information.
Remarks line 4: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
